steps.name: portable-boot-without-vite-server
steps.observation: Embedded interface opened and online street map roads, labels and water rendered visually.

steps.name: gui-usb-connect
steps.observation: Selected USB iPhone reached Ready with a trusted developer session.

steps.name: gui-times-square-teleport
steps.observation: Times Square request reached Location active; this records protocol/UI state only and has no owner-confirmed phone observation.

steps.name: gui-disconnect-recovery
steps.observation: After the phone was removed, the UI reported that the selected USB iPhone was no longer connected and retained the last applied location.

steps.name: legacy-restoration-journal-upgrade-preparation
steps.observation: A sanitized schema-1 restoration journal containing only a selected-device request was observed in the prior app-data location; the exact old portable process was stopped after persistence. No phone command was sent. This is migration evidence only, not X/Exit or Clear/phone-restoration proof.

steps.name: persisted-real-pending-restore-loaded
steps.observation: The current portable GUI loaded the persisted real pending-restore obligation after the legacy upgrade.

steps.name: x-pending-dialog
steps.observation: Using the actual window close path displayed the pending-restoration dialog in the GUI.

steps.name: close-confirm-and-reopen
steps.observation: Final confirmation that the explicit close choice persists and the next launch reopens with the reminder remains under root verification.

steps.name: gui-retarget-clear-and-device-visible-restore
steps.observation: The phone was removed before Restore/Clear and no further phone operation was attempted.

steps.name: gui-close-latency-and-active-session-cleanup
steps.observation: An earlier fresh GUI close left the window absent at a later check, but exact latency and active-session cleanup were not measured in this run.

scope: Portable GUI smoke and disconnect-recovery observation; not a complete graphical phone-control acceptance.
